fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2011 Hyundai Santa Fe SUV.
findings: Interior already looks clean overall: gray cloth seats front and rear show no obvious stains
Some light lint and debris on the driver's carpet floor mat
A cooler bag and items left on the rear passenger floor
Rear bumper lower black trim looks slightly faded and dull
Rear paint on the liftgate looks a bit flat rather than glossy, with some dust along the lower bumper
Stickers on the liftgate near the badge
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Santa Fe and the interior already looks well kept. A quick pre-sale detail could freshen the driver's floor mat, clear out the rear floor, and bring back some gloss to the gray paint and the faded black trim on the rear bumper. We come to you. Would you like a quote?
